description:
Activate Fleetwheel Cruiser by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to any target and three damage to itself.
Fleetwheel Cruiser dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Shelob triggers, creating a token copy of Fleetwheel Cruiser that is a Food artifact.
When the Fleetwheel Cruiser token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat.
